partners_or_opponents: vs. two players from the Wednesday ladder
arrived: Rough week. Haven't slept well in almost three weeks now, mood has been low, everything feels a bit gray. Told Rhea I was tired.
session_narrative: Doubles. Won 6-3, 6-4. One double fault the whole match. Serve completely fell apart, I could feel it — every second serve I was bracing for it to go long. First serves were going in. Rhea carried the net, put away a lot of volleys off my returns. Tactically we did the same thing we always do, cross-cross-poach, worked fine.
take_away: Serve fell apart. Won on Rhea's net play. I need a break from the serve mentally, it's living in my head.
